decisions.reason: Correcting table-of-contents page references depends on finalized pagination but does not change the existing article order or placement rules.
The table-of-contents accuracy decision does not alter the flipbook deliverable or its two-page-spread display behavior.
Accurate table-of-contents page references do not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The table-of-contents correction does not change the article body-font requirement.
Updating table-of-contents page numbers does not add, remove, or otherwise change the content required in the issue.
The table-of-contents page-number correction does not change the standard or permitted methods for balancing article-ending whitespace.
Correct table-of-contents pagination has no effect on author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or image source.
The table-of-contents accuracy decision does not modify the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color-use rule.
Correcting table-of-contents page references does not change the requirement to enhance publication images when needed.
The table-of-contents update does not alter how uninterrupted article text should be balanced with images, blurbs, or quotes.
The request for accurate table-of-contents page numbers does not establish a new launch date or modify the existing deadline.
